description: List leads in a campaign, optionally filtered by state (e.g. "qualified" for the human-approval queue, "approved", "sent", "replied"). Shows each lead's handle, AI score, qualification reason, and the drafted or approved message. Read-only. Approving a lead is a separate step (dm_lead_approve).

state.description: Filter by lead state. Use "qualified" to see the leads waiting for human approval.

name: dm_leads_list
